description: Searches Google Shopping and returns up to 20 product offers from many merchants (title, url, price, merchant, rating, reviews_count), localized by country and language. Use it to compare what different stores charge for a product. It does not return price history or stock levels, and is not for listings on one marketplace (use amazon_product, search_walmart or search_ebay). Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter country code that localizes the shops and prices, e.g. "it" or "gb". Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the product text, e.g. "en" or "it". Omit for the source default, en.

page.description: Zero-based results page, integer from 0: 0 is the first page, 1 the second, e.g. 1. Omit for the first page; each page is a separate charged call.

query.description: Product search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "running shoes size 42".

results.description: Maximum products returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: google_shopping_prices
title: Google Shopping Prices
